images.caption: I don't know if any of us has enough gumption to be reincarnated as wild salmon. These fish are nearing the end of their amazing and perilous journey up the Yukon River when seen here in the holding pen at the top of the fishladder at the Whitehorse power dam. Every stroke and gasp is dedicated to reaching a grand finale far up a mountain stream. Only the fittest (and luckiest) of the species will spawn in the gravel bed where each began its great circle of life.
images.alt: I don't know if any of us has enough gumption to be reincarnated as wild salmon. These fish are nearing the end of their amazing and perilous journey up the Yukon River when seen here in the holding pen at the top of the fishladder at the Whitehorse power dam. Every stroke and gasp is dedicated to reaching a grand finale far up a mountain stream. Only the fittest (and luckiest) of the species will spawn in the gravel bed where each began its great circle of life.

images.caption: The Yukon's power grid is isolated.  In fact there are two power grids in the territory, and they are not only isolated from other parts of the country, but from each other.  Ninety percent of the Yukon's power is hydroelectric.
images.alt: The Yukon's power grid is isolated.  In fact there are two power grids in the territory, and they are not only isolated from other parts of the country, but from each other.  Ninety percent of the Yukon's power is hydroelectric.
